verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אַתָּ֤ה זָקַ֙נְתָּה֙ בָּ֣אתָ בַיָּמִ֔ים מְאֹ֖ד הַרְבֵּֽה־ וְהָאָ֛רֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָ֥ה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ zā·qên bā bay·yā·mîm Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’at·tāh zā·qan·tāh bā·ṯā ḇay·yā·mîm mə·’ōḏ har·bêh- wə·hā·’ā·reṣ niš·’ă·rāh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: Now Joshua was old [and] well along in years and the LORD said to him You are old [and] well along in years but very much of the land remains to be possessed

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָאָ֖רֶץ הַנִּשְׁאָ֑רֶת כָּל־ גְּלִיל֥וֹת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְכָל־ הַגְּשׁוּרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ han·niš·’ā·reṯ kāl- gə·lî·lō·wṯ hap·pə·liš·tîm wə·ḵāl hag·gə·šū·rî
verses.literal: This is the land that remains All the territory of the Philistines . . . and the Geshurites

verses.original: מִֽן־ הַשִּׁיח֞וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֗יִם וְעַ֨ד גְּב֤וּל עֶקְרוֹן֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה תֵּחָשֵׁ֑ב לַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים סַרְנֵ֣י הָעַזָּתִ֤י וְהָאַשְׁדּוֹדִי֙ הָאֶשְׁקְלוֹנִ֣י הַגִּתִּ֔י וְהָעֶקְרוֹנִ֖י וְהָעַוִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: min- haš·šî·ḥō·wr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ gə·ḇūl ‘eq·rō·wn ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh tê·ḥā·šêḇ lak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ḥă·mê·šeṯ p̄ə·liš·tîm sar·nê hā·‘az·zā·ṯî wə·hā·’aš·dō·w·ḏî hā·’eš·qə·lō·w·nî hag·git·tî wə·hā·‘eq·rō·w·nî wə·hā·‘aw·wîm
verses.literal: from the Shihor - east . . . of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite [territory]) that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza Ashdod Ashkelon Gath and Ekron as well as that of the Avvites

verses.original: מִתֵּימָ֞ן כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וּמְעָרָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַצִּידֹנִ֖ים עַד־ אֲפֵ֑קָה עַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mit·tê·mān kāl- ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ū·mə·‘ā·rāh ’ă·šer laṣ·ṣî·ḏō·nîm ‘aḏ- ’ă·p̄ê·qāh ‘aḏ gə·ḇūl hā·’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: to the south all the land of the Canaanites from Mearah of the Sidonians to Aphek as far as the border of the Amorites

verses.original: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ הַגִּבְלִ֗י וְכָל־ הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מִבַּ֣עַל גָּ֔ד תַּ֖חַת הַר־ חֶרְמ֑וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ hag·giḇ·lî wə·ḵāl hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn miz·raḥ haš·še·meš mib·ba·‘al gāḏ ta·ḥaṯ har- ḥer·mō·wn ‘aḏ lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ
verses.literal: the land of the Gebalites and all Lebanon to the east . . . vvv from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to vvv Lebo-hamath

verses.original: כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ֠הָר מִֽן־ הַלְּבָנ֞וֹן עַד־ מִשְׂרְפֹ֥ת מַ֙יִם֙ כָּל־ צִ֣ידֹנִ֔ים אָֽנֹכִי֙ אוֹרִישֵׁ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק הַפִּלֶ֤הָ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·hār min- hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ‘aḏ- miś·rə·p̄ōṯ ma·yim kāl- ṣî·ḏō·nîm ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ō·w·rî·šêm mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl raq hap·pi·le·hā bə·na·ḥă·lāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā
verses.literal: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to vvv Misrephoth-maim all the Sidonians I Myself will drive out before the Israelites . . . Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel as I have commanded you

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה חַלֵּ֞ק אֶת־ הַזֹּ֛את הָאָ֧רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְתִשְׁעַ֣ת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים וַחֲצִ֖י הַשֵּׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḥal·lêq ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ bə·na·ḥă·lāh lə·ṯiš·‘aṯ haš·šə·ḇā·ṭîm wa·ḥă·ṣî haš·šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šeh
verses.literal: Now therefore divide - this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh

verses.original: עִמּ֗וֹ הָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְהַגָּדִ֔י לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֩ מֹשֶׁ֗ה נָתַ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם
verses.transliteration: ‘im·mōw hā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·hag·gā·ḏî lā·qə·ḥū na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ’ă·šer mō·šeh nā·ṯan lā·hem bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên miz·rā·ḥāh ka·’ă·šer mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh nā·ṯan lā·hem
verses.literal: The other [half of Manasseh] along with the Reubenites and Gadites had received the inheritance Moses had given them beyond the Jordan to the east just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned to them

verses.original: מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ אַרְנ֜וֹן נַ֨חַל וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־ הַמִּישֹׁ֥ר מֵידְבָ֖א עַד־ דִּיבֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- ’ar·nō·wn na·ḥal wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ- han·na·ḥal wə·ḵāl ham·mî·šōr mê·ḏə·ḇā ‘aḏ- dî·ḇō·wn
verses.literal: [The area] from Aroer - on the rim of the Arnon Valley along with the city - in the middle of the valley the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon

verses.original: וְכֹ֗ל עָרֵי֙ סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן עַד־ גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ‘ā·rê sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer mā·laḵ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn ‘aḏ- gə·ḇūl bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon as far as the border of the Ammonites . . .

verses.original: וְהַגִּלְעָ֞ד וּגְב֧וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֣י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֗י וְכֹ֨ל הַ֥ר חֶרְמ֛וֹן וְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן עַד־ סַלְכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hag·gil·‘āḏ ū·ḡə·ḇūl hag·gə·šū·rî wə·ham·ma·‘ă·ḵā·ṯî wə·ḵōl har ḥer·mō·wn wə·ḵāl hab·bā·šān ‘aḏ- sal·ḵāh
verses.literal: also Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salecah

verses.original: כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֥וּת עוֹג֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־ מָלַ֥ךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי ה֤וּא נִשְׁאַר֙ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִ֔ים מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיַּכֵּ֥ם וַיֹּרִשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mam·lə·ḵūṯ ‘ō·wḡ bab·bā·šān ’ă·šer- mā·laḵ bə·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·’eḏ·re·‘î hū niš·’ar mî·ye·ṯer hā·rə·p̄ā·’îm mō·šeh way·yak·kêm way·yō·ri·šêm
verses.literal: the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei - and had remained as a remnant of the Rephaim Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ וְלֹ֤א הוֹרִ֙ישׁוּ֙ הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י גְּשׁ֤וּר וּמַֽעֲכָת֙ וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב בְּקֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃ הַיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- wə·lō hō·w·rî·šū hag·gə·šū·rî wə·’eṯ- ham·ma·‘ă·ḵā·ṯî gə·šūr ū·ma·‘ă·ḵāṯ way·yê·šeḇ bə·qe·reḇ yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ haz·zeh hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: but the Israelites . . . - did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites So Geshur and Maacath dwell among the Israelites to this day

verses.original: לְשֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י רַ֚ק נָתַ֖ן לֹ֥א נַחֲלָ֑ה אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·šê·ḇeṭ hal·lê·wî raq nā·ṯan lō na·ḥă·lāh ’iš·šê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hū na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer dib·ber- lōw
verses.literal: To the tribe of Levi however [Moses] had given no inheritance The food offerings to the LORD the God of Israel are their inheritance just as He had promised them

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵ֖ן
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yit·tên lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên
verses.literal: [This is what] Moses had given to the clans of the tribe vvv of Reuben

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֜ם הַגְּב֗וּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ אַרְנ֜וֹן נַ֨חַל וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־ הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר עַל־ מֵידְבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·hem hag·gə·ḇūl mê·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- ’ar·nō·wn na·ḥal wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ- han·na·ḥal wə·ḵāl ham·mî·šōr ‘al- mê·ḏə·ḇā
verses.literal: - - The territory from Aroer - on the rim of the Arnon Valley along with the city - in the middle of the valley to the whole plateau beyond Medeba

verses.original: חֶשְׁבּ֥וֹן וְכָל־ עָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֑ר דִּיבוֹן֙ וּבָמ֣וֹת בַּ֔עַל וּבֵ֖ית בַּ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥeš·bō·wn wə·ḵāl ‘ā·re·hā ’ă·šer bam·mî·šōr dî·ḇō·wn ū·ḇā·mō·wṯ ba·‘al ū·ḇêṯ ba·‘al mə·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: to Heshbon and all its cities - on the plateau including Dibon vvv Bamoth-baal vvv vvv Beth-baal-meon

verses.original: וְיַ֥הְצָה וּקְדֵמֹ֖ת וּמֵפָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yah·ṣāh ū·qə·ḏê·mōṯ ū·mê·p̄ā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Jahaz Kedemoth Mephaath

verses.original: וְקִרְיָתַ֣יִם וְשִׂבְמָ֔ה וְצֶ֥רֶת הַשַּׁ֖חַר בְּהַ֥ר הָעֵֽמֶק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qir·yā·ṯa·yim wə·śiḇ·māh wə·ṣe·reṯ haš·ša·ḥar bə·har hā·‘ê·meq
verses.literal: Kiriathaim Sibmah vvv Zereth-shahar on the hill in the valley

verses.original: וּבֵ֥ית פְּע֛וֹר וְאַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית הַיְשִׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇêṯ pə·‘ō·wr wə·’aš·dō·wṯ hap·pis·gāh ū·ḇêṯ hay·ši·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: vvv Beth-peor the slopes of Pisgah vvv and Beth-jeshimoth

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֔ר וְכָֽל־ מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁר֩ מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֹת֣וֹ׀ וְאֶת־ הִכָּ֨ה נְשִׂיאֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת־ אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־ רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־ צ֤וּר וְאֶת־ חוּר֙ וְאֶת־ רֶ֔בַע נְסִיכֵ֣י סִיח֔וֹן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ‘ā·rê ham·mî·šōr wə·ḵāl mam·lə·ḵūṯ sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer mā·laḵ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn ’ă·šer mō·šeh ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- hik·kāh nə·śî·’ê miḏ·yān ’eṯ- ’ĕ·wî wə·’eṯ- re·qem wə·’eṯ- ṣūr wə·’eṯ- ḥūr wə·’eṯ- re·ḇa‘ nə·sî·ḵê sî·ḥō·wn yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: all the cities of the plateau and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon [until] Moses - - killed him and the chiefs of Midian - Evi - Rekem - Zur - Hur - and Reba the princes of Sihon who lived in the land

verses.original: בֶּן־ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאֶת־ הַקּוֹסֵ֑ם בִּלְעָ֥ם בְּע֖וֹר הָרְג֧וּ בַּחֶ֖רֶב אֶל־ חַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- haq·qō·w·sêm bil·‘ām bə·‘ō·wr hā·rə·ḡū ba·ḥe·reḇ ’el- ḥal·lê·hem
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . also [killed] the diviner Balaam son of Beor [ along with the others] they put to the sword . . . . . .

verses.original: גְּבוּל֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַיְהִ֗י וּגְב֑וּל הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן זֹ֣את נַחֲלַ֤ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם בְּנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵן֙ הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: gə·ḇūl bə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên way·hî ū·ḡə·ḇūl hay·yar·dên zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām bə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hen
verses.literal: And the border of the Reubenites . . . was the bank of the Jordan This was the inheritance of the clans of the Reubenites . . . including the cities and villages

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ לְמַטֵּה־ לִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד גָ֔ד
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yit·tên lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lə·maṭ·ṭêh- liḇ·nê- ḡāḏ ḡāḏ
verses.literal: [This is what] Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad . . . . . .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ הַגְּב֔וּל יַעְזֵר֙ וְכָל־ עָרֵ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וַחֲצִ֕י אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן עַד־ עֲרוֹעֵ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י רַבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·hem hag·gə·ḇūl ya‘·zêr wə·ḵāl ‘ā·rê hag·gil·‘āḏ wa·ḥă·ṣî ’e·reṣ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ‘aḏ- ‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê rab·bāh
verses.literal: - The territory of Jazer all the cities of Gilead and half the land of the Ammonites . . . as far as Aroer - near . . . Rabbah

verses.original: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עַד־ רָמַ֥ת הַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וּבְטֹנִ֑ים וּמִֽמַּחֲנַ֖יִם עַד־ גְּב֥וּל לִדְבִֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·ḥeš·bō·wn ‘aḏ- rā·maṯ ham·miṣ·peh ū·ḇə·ṭō·nîm ū·mim·ma·ḥă·na·yim ‘aḏ- gə·ḇūl liḏ·ḇir
verses.literal: [the territory] from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh . . . and Betonim and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir

verses.original: וּבָעֵ֡מֶק בֵּ֣ית הָרָם֩ וּבֵ֨ית נִמְרָ֜ה וְסֻכּ֣וֹת וְצָפ֗וֹן יֶ֚תֶר מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְבֻ֑ל מִזְרָֽחָה׃ עֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן עַד־ קְצֵה֙ יָם־ כִּנֶּ֔רֶת
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·‘ê·meq bêṯ hā·rām ū·ḇêṯ nim·rāh wə·suk·kō·wṯ wə·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ye·ṯer mam·lə·ḵūṯ sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn hay·yar·dên ū·ḡə·ḇul miz·rā·ḥāh ‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh yām- kin·ne·reṯ
verses.literal: and in the valley vvv Beth-haram vvv Beth-nimrah Succoth and Zaphon with the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon - (the territory on the east side of the Jordan up to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵי־ גָ֖ד הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām bə·nê- ḡāḏ he·‘ā·rîm wə·ḥaṣ·rê·hem
verses.literal: This was the inheritance of the clans of the Gadites . . . including the cities and villages

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃ לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י לַחֲצִ֛י מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yit·tên lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh way·hî la·ḥă·ṣî maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: [This is what] Moses had given to the clans of the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh that is to half the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מִמַּחֲנַ֨יִם כָּֽל־ הַבָּשָׁ֜ן כָּֽל־ מַמְלְכ֣וּת׀ ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן וְכָל־ חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḡə·ḇū·lām mim·ma·ḥă·na·yim kāl- hab·bā·šān kāl- mam·lə·ḵūṯ ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ- hab·bā·šān wə·ḵāl ḥaw·wōṯ yā·’îr ’ă·šer bab·bā·šān šiš·šîm ‘îr
verses.literal: - The territory from Mahanaim through all Bashan all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan including all the towns of Jair that are in Bashan sixty cities

verses.original: וַחֲצִ֤י הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַשְׁתָּר֣וֹת וְאֶדְרֶ֔עִי מַמְלְכ֥וּת עָרֵ֛י ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָׁ֑ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃ לִבְנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֥י בְנֵֽי־ מָכִ֖יר
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·ṣî hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ wə·’eḏ·re·‘î mam·lə·ḵūṯ ‘ā·rê ‘ō·wḡ bab·bā·šān lə·miš·pə·ḥō·w·ṯām liḇ·nê mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh la·ḥă·ṣî ḇə·nê- mā·ḵîr
verses.literal: half of Gilead and Ashtaroth and Edrei the royal cities of Og in Bashan [All this was] for the clans of the descendants of Machir son of Manasseh that is, half of the descendants of Machir

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה נִחַ֥ל בְּעַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֑ב מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃ס יְרִיח֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ’ă·šer- mō·šeh ni·ḥal bə·‘ar·ḇō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ mê·‘ê·ḇer lə·yar·dên miz·rā·ḥāh yə·rî·ḥōw
verses.literal: These - {were the portions} Moses had given them on the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan east of Jericho

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֙בֶט֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י מֹשֶׁ֖ה נָתַ֥ן לֹֽא־ נַחֲלָ֑ה יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šê·ḇeṭ hal·lê·wî mō·šeh nā·ṯan lō- na·ḥă·lāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hū na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ka·’ă·šer dib·ber lā·hem
verses.literal: To the tribe of Levi however [Moses] had given no inheritance The LORD the God of Israel . . . is their inheritance just as He had promised them
